_comment: VERIFIED deep ticket/event pages, scraped from each VENUE'S OWN programme page. Purpose: the calendar ships many ticket links pointing at a venue's bare HOMEPAGE, so a reader who clicks 'Tickets' lands on a splash page and has to hunt for the show. Measured on the live site 15 Jul 2026: 20 of 46 ticketed events (43%) did not reach a buying page. build_site.py's venue_resolve() upgrades a homepage/listing link to the real event page using ONLY entries verified here. NEVER hand-guess a slug (Marenostrum: 'beele-nanpabasico-lewispotter', 'underworld-live-satisfaxion-303' - not derivable). No verified match => the calendar's own link is left untouched. Regenerated by Tools/agent/refresh_venue_map.py. | 2026-08-14: removed the whole nerjacultura block (its only act, 'Antonio Cortes 14/09/2026', came from a manual seed and traced back to a nerja.es PRESS RELEASE dated 10 Sep 2024 about a 14 Sep 2024 concert; cultura.nerja.es, mientrada.net and tomaticket list no 2026 date). Removed on DLR's ruling 2026-08-14. Block deleted rather than emptied so no complete:true block with zero acts can arm the phantom gate; refresh_townhalls.py will recreate it only if cultura.nerja.es actually returns music events.

cartel malaga.note: LINK-OVERRIDE BLOCK - do NOT reorder, do NOT rename, do NOT add a scraper for it. Why it exists (DLR ruling 2026-08-14, after the 08-11 'cannot be fixed from data alone' finding): the calendar ships Damian Cordoba (3 Sep, Sala Trinchera) with ticket link salatrinchera.com/cartel-malaga-2/, which is the venue's general POSTER LISTING, not his buying page. _is_deep() calls that URL 'deep' (its last path segment is 'cartel-malaga-2', not one of the generic stop-words), so venue_resolve's normal upgrade path refuses to touch it, and the 'trinchera' block is rewritten wholesale from mutick every Monday by refresh_venue_map.py, which strips any hand-added 'prefer' field - that is what made the earlier fixes evaporate. HOW THIS ONE STICKS: (1) the key 'cartel malaga' is NOT in refresh_venue_map.VENUES nor refresh_townhalls.TOWNHALLS, so no weekly job rewrites it; (2) _venue_lookup() matches a block when the key is a substring of the normalised VENUE or URL - 'cartel malaga' appears ONLY in this one bad listing URL ('https salatrinchera com cartel malaga 2'), never in 'sala trinchera' nor in any mutick.com/e/ link, so this block can only ever capture rows pointing at that listing and shadows nothing else; (3) prefer:'eci' is the one documented data flag that makes venue_resolve take the mapped URL even when the calendar's link is already deep. ORDER MATTERS: this block must stay ABOVE 'trinchera' in this file - 'trinchera' also matches that URL, and _venue_lookup returns the FIRST matching block. complete:false on purpose so it can never phantom-drop anything; any other act on that listing URL simply falls through with its link untouched. DESTINATION BROWSER-CONFIRMED 2026-08-14 (Chrome, sofia@): movingtickets.com shows 'Damian Cordoba en Sala Trinchera', 03.09.2026 21:00, Sala Trinchera C/ Parauta 25 Malaga, 25.00 EUR + 2.50 g.g = 27.50 EUR, live COMPRAR button. Same URL already sits in verified_ticket_links.json and movingtickets.com is already a trusted host, so the verifier will not drop it. TO RETIRE: once 3 Sep 2026 has passed this whole block can be deleted.

This block is not in refresh_townhalls.TOWNHALLS nor refresh_venue_map.VENUES, so nothing rewrites it, and its key 'marbella es agenda' only ever appears inside a normalised marbella.es/agenda URL - it can capture nothing else. complete:false and not in backfill's WHITELIST, so it can never inject or phantom-drop; an unmapped Marbella agenda row just falls through unchanged. BROWSER-CONFIRMED 2026-08-14 (Chrome, sofia@): the town hall's own Noches de Tango page states 'Entrada 25 EUR - venta en la taquilla y en www.mientrada.net' and links to the mientrada page, which shows 20 agosto 2026, 22:00, Auditorio Jose Pernia Calderon, 25 EUR and a live COMPRAR ENTRADAS button. TWO KEYS, AND THE BARE WORD 'unicaja' IS DELIBERATELY NOT ONE OF THEM. Fever writes 'Sala Fundación Unicaja Mª Cristina' while its own listing pages use 'Sala Unicaja de Conciertos María Cristina', so one key cannot cover both — and a bare 'unicaja' key WOULD ALSO MATCH 'Castillo Sohail - Escenario Unicaja (Marenostrum)', the Fuengirola festival ground. _venue_lookup returns the FIRST key that matches, so a bare 'unicaja' key only resolved Castillo Sohail correctly by accident of dict ordering; re-sorting this file would have silently stolen Castillo Sohail from the 'marenostrum' entry and broken its prefer=eci routing (23 acts, a live revenue path). Hence 'fundacion unicaja' + 'unicaja de conciertos', neither of which appears in the Castillo Sohail string. 'maria cristina' alone is not usable either: it misses Fever's 'Mª' abbreviation. complete:false => NO phantom gate and NOT backfill-eligible. Deliberate: we do not hold this venue's full programme (it runs a long classical season we do not track), so a complete:true entry would DROP any real concert missing from the acts list. Its own season programme (PDF, Oct 2025-May 2026) is at fundacionunicaja.com if we ever want to carry the classical bill too.

'maria cristina' alone is not usable either: it misses Fever's 'Mª' abbreviation. complete:false => NO phantom gate and NOT backfill-eligible. Deliberate: we do not hold this venue's full programme (it runs a long classical season we do not track), so a complete:true entry would DROP any real concert missing from the acts list. Its own season programme (PDF, Oct 2025-May 2026) is at fundacionunicaja.com if we ever want to carry the classical bill too.

edgar neville.note: Added 2026-08-10 (Sofia). Auditorio Edgar Neville, C/ Pacifico 54, Malaga city - the Diputacion de Malaga's own 600-seat auditorium. mientrada.net is its OFFICIAL ticketer (the Junta's Agenda Cultural de Andalucia venue page links there under 'Comprar entradas'). complete:FALSE ON PURPOSE. We do NOT hold this venue's full bill, and complete:true would arm the phantom gate - build_site would then DELETE any Edgar Neville event the sweep legitimately found but that we had not pre-listed. False = venue recognised + links upgradeable, nothing dropped, nothing injected. Flip to true only if we ever mirror its whole programme. CURATION WARNING: this is a mostly INSTITUTIONAL room - congresses, award ceremonies, short-film weeks, book presentations, conferences - with concerts as a minority of the bill. Most of what it programmes is NOT live music. Same trap as the Torremolinos 'Musica' feed. VERIFIED 2026-08-10: nothing on sale anywhere - mientrada venue page and category page both return 'No se ha encontrado ningun resultado', the per-venue iCal export is empty, and taquilla.com says 'No hemos encontrado entradas a la venta'. So there is nothing to list today; this entry plus the source_calendar checklist exist so the first concert they DO announce is picked up automatically. NOTE: malaga.es (Diputacion agenda) returns an EMPTY body to our fetcher, so it cannot be relied on as a scrape target - mientrada.net is the workable source.

trinchera.note: Sala La Trinchera, ~650-cap independent venue, Malaga city. Regular concert programme, heavy on UK/US heritage acts. SOURCE CHANGED 2026-08-10 (Sofia): it used to point at salatrinchera.com/proximos-eventos/, which is JS-rendered and returns an EMPTY page - so for two weeks this venue was 'covered' by a URL nothing could read, and its shows were never found. Its ticketer mutick.com is fully server-rendered and lists the whole ticketed programme. complete:false - mutick shows only TICKETED shows and the venue may run more, so arming the phantom gate could delete real events. VERIFIED on mutick 2026-08-10: China Crisis (UK) 17 Sep 2026, The Silencers (UK) 15 Oct 2026, Clearwater Creedence Revival (UK&USA) 29 Nov 2026 - all beyond the 30-day window on that date; China Crisis enters the calendar window at the Mon 24 Aug sweep. KEY RENAMED 2026-08-10 'sala trinchera' -> 'trinchera'. _venue_lookup() matches only when the KEY IS A SUBSTRING of the normalised venue name or URL. The venue calls itself 'Sala LA Trinchera', and 'sala trinchera' is NOT a substring of 'sala la trinchera' - so this block could never match anything, no matter what was in it. Bare 'trinchera' matches every spelling and the mutick slug sala-la-trinchera too. AUTO-REFRESH ADDED 2026-08-10: refresh_venue_map.py now rescrapes this block every Monday from mutick.com/l/malaga - the CITY-scoped page, never mutick as a whole, because mutick is a national Madrid-based platform and a site-wide scrape would drag in Madrid listings. Rows are kept only when the card names 'trinchera', so the same city page can serve other Malaga venues later. After the first refresh 'source' above will read /l/malaga (what is actually scraped) rather than the venue page. COMPLETE FLIPPED TO TRUE 2026-08-10 (Sofia: 'as long as China Crisis appears in the event list'). complete:false could not deliver that - backfill only injects from complete venues, so the listing depended entirely on the LLM sweep, which this codebase documents as intermittently dropping whole venues. True makes injection DETERMINISTIC. The price of that is the phantom gate: a Trinchera show that is NOT on mutick and that the sweep finds elsewhere would now be dropped as 'not on trinchera's own programme'. Judged acceptable because mutick IS the venue's ticketer and refresh_venue_map.py now re-reads it every Monday, so the list cannot go stale. To reverse, set complete back to false - one word.
